title: Walk a linked phone book
description: You can follow how records are added at the front and searched by name.

steps.description: Entry stores a name, extension, and next pointer. book starts as NULL, representing an empty list.
find follows next pointers from book. It returns the matching entry or NULL after reaching the end.
add allocates a record and copies its name. It points the new record at the previous front, then updates book.

steps.question: Which entry is at the front after the two add calls?
steps.answer: library is at the front because it was added second.

steps.description: The search still reaches registrar and displays its extension 3000. The absent bursar name produces no in the final message.
